summary: Remove the retired catalog event and resource supervisor family

replay.detail: Removes obsolete catalog event/resync publishers and resource supervisors with no current product entry point. Current native graph delivery and replay remain.

schema.detail: No schema change or data deletion. Existing catalog event, resource, park and runtime files stay on disk.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, wire contraction, digests or member activation changes.

compatibility.detail: Removes workspace-internal catalog event, execution backend, isolation wrapper, park, resource observation/profile/supervisor, resync and task inventory APIs. Current native runtime isolation, shared file/lock primitives, declaration parsing, migration consumers and compatibility readers remain.

downtime.detail: No active native supervisor, driver or delivery loop changes.

manual.detail: No cleanup is required; old catalog state remains on disk.

recovery.detail: No new store recovery or downgrade requirement. Reverting restores source only; persisted state is unchanged.
